demonstrates: What a freshly created environment opens with -- a preview, a fresh clone, a stage nobody has written in yet. Entries chosen to be LOOKED AT rather than asserted about: they carry the round-trip properties that make a screen worth judging (characters outside ASCII, a message with line breaks, a short one beside a long one) and no value anywhere near a published limit, because a signature padded to eighty characters is a screen nobody can read.

entries.author: The template
entries.message: Welcome. This guest book was filled when the environment was created, so there is something on the screen to judge. Every entry here arrived the way a guest's entry arrives -- posted through the API, and subject to the same rules.

entries.message: café · naïve · Ærø · 日本語 · Ωμέγα — the characters above ASCII are here on purpose: if they survive as far as your eyes, they survived the database, the contract and the browser.
